name: baseline-shipped
hypothesis: shipped causal 20-bar momentum baseline captures trend after 10:00 CT
outcome: zero passes all 14 years; MES pnl -273k MGC -559k over 3406 sessions; churn/fees dominate
mechanism: per-bar mean-cross momentum flips too fast; fees 81k+207k

name: on-drift-hold
hypothesis: hold MES+MNQ+M2K 17:00->09:00 CT long captures overnight equity drift; score>0 all 2020-23
outcome: gate passed (2020 .113, 2021 .009, 2022 .013, 2023 .009) but negative total pnl -530k: DLL intrabar locks on 741/1204 days flatten at adverse prices; M2K illiquid ON destroys -402k on fees/locks; MES -84k MNQ -45k
mechanism: adverse simultaneous-extreme valuation + no stop discipline = locks; overnight illiquidity (M2K) toxic

name: on-drift-stop
hypothesis: hard stop at 35% of 20-session ON range cuts left tail; lifts pass rates
outcome: gate fail: 2021 0.0, 2023 0.0; 2020 .18, 2022 .03, 2019 .035. total -124k, stops+fees eat drift; entries 6762 => churn worse than exp2 on MES (-102k vs -84k)
mechanism: stop too tight vs ON noise at entry hour; early-evening whipsaw exits before 00:00-08:30 accumulation leg

name: orb-30min
hypothesis: 30-min opening-range breakout on MES/MNQ/M2K, entries >=09:35 CT, stop opposite extreme, $300 risk
outcome: gate pass (2020 .061 2021 .017 2022 .144 2023 .031; 2019 0.0). total -18.7k; fees 16.3k. Gross: MNQ long +4852, short side +7930 in 2022 but -5150 in 2023; 2019 both sides negative. 2.8 entries/day
mechanism: ORB roughly breakeven gross, regime dependent; worst-3 years = 2019(.0) 2021(.017) 2023(.031)
